result: Run 2026-10-12 against live Vertex AI on gemini-3.5-flash, planner prompt v6. ADK planner evalsets (46, the same 46 built from the 28 Sep gemini-2.5-flash recordings): **response match 43/46** (final response matched the recording at >= 0.8; 9 Oct, gemini-2.5-flash, planner prompt v6, pre-switch: 38/46). Exact trajectory match passes **1/46**, so 1/46 pass both metrics (9 Oct, gemini-2.5-flash, pre-switch: 6/46 and 6/46). The trajectory number fell: of the 45 trajectory failures, the recording has 2 or more propose_play attempts in 41, while gemini-3.5-flash proposed the play on its first attempt in 40 (4 needed 2 attempts, 1 needed 3); the recordings come from gemini-2.5-flash, so it measures departure from the old model's retry pattern, not planner correctness. The 3 response-match misses are evalsets whose 28 Sep recording ended with an empty final turn (reference text empty); the model returned a play in all three. Failure classes over the 45 trajectory failures (`adk_vertex/divergence.json`): 26 differ in both the propose_play retry count and the estimate/guardrail count, 17 in propose_play retries only, 2 in estimate/guardrail counts only. Rationale judge (same 15 plays and rubric as 21 Sep and 9 Oct; judge model gemini-3.5-flash): **15/15 score >= 4.0, mean 5.0/5**; the two negative sanity checks were not re-run, and a perfect score from a judge of the same model family is weak evidence. The planner prompt was v6 (origin/main f7af482); prompt v7 (PR 98) was not on main at run time, so this is not a measurement of v7. No quota or billing error occurred. Note (14 Oct): this 43/46 and 1/46 are dated history of the 28 Sep set; the 46 evalsets in the repo were re-recorded on 14 Oct from gemini-3.5-flash, planner prompt v7 (`agents/planner/evalsets/PROVENANCE.json`); the 28 Sep set is at `git show 6482e7c:agents/planner/evalsets/<file>`.
